// @pit: {"label": "Update docs: prompts, how-it-works, security, README, action.yml, CONTRIBUTING, inputs.ts"}
async ({ workspace: { read, edit } }) => {
  const edits: Record<string, [string, string][]> = {
    "docs/prompts.md": [
      [`pi-action loads context files as pi's coding agent does:

1. **Global:** \`<agent_dir>/AGENTS.md\`, or else \`<agent_dir>/CLAUDE.md\`. Only when \`agent_dir\` is set.
2. **Workspace:** for each directory from the workspace root (\`GITHUB_WORKSPACE\`) down to the working directory of the agent: \`AGENTS.md\`, or else \`CLAUDE.md\`. Today,`,
`pi-action loads context files as pi's coding agent does. In each directory, it loads the first of these files that exists: \`AGENTS.override.md\`, \`AGENTS.md\`, \`AGENTS.MD\`, \`CLAUDE.md\`, \`CLAUDE.MD\`. It skips a directory with one of these names.

1. **Global:** the file in \`agent_dir\`. Only when \`agent_dir\` is set.
2. **Workspace:** the file in each directory from the workspace root (\`GITHUB_WORKSPACE\`) down to the working directory of the agent. Today,`],
      [`(for example \`packages/api/AGENTS.md\`) are not loaded. The section lists their paths (up to 20)`, `(for example \`packages/api/AGENTS.md\`) are not loaded. The section lists their paths (up to 20, one for each directory)`],
      [`The section looks like this:

\`\`\`text
<project_context>
# Project Context

Project-specific instructions and guidelines:

## /home/runner/work/xyz/xyz/AGENTS.md

<file contents>

More context files: packages/api/AGENTS.md. Read the one for the directory you work in.
</project_context>
\`\`\``, `The section has pi's layout: one \`<project_instructions>\` block for each file, with its content trimmed. pi-action's notes come after the files: the nested files, the files cut or left out at the size limit, and the base commit of a pull request from a fork. The section looks like this:

\`\`\`text
<project_context>
Project-specific instructions and guidelines:

<project_instructions path="/home/runner/work/xyz/xyz/AGENTS.md">
<file contents>
</project_instructions>

More context files: packages/api/AGENTS.md. Read the one for the directory you work in.
</project_context>
\`\`\`

A thread from pi-action 0.x before this layout gets one \`Updated system prompt section "project_context"\` in its next run.`],
    ],
    "docs/how-it-works.md": [[`pi-action reads \`AGENTS.md\` one time for each run.`, `pi-action reads the context files (\`AGENTS.md\` and the other names that pi uses) one time for each run.`]],
    "docs/security.md": [[`\`AGENTS.md\` and \`CLAUDE.md\` go into the system prompt`, `The context files (\`AGENTS.override.md\`, \`AGENTS.md\`, \`CLAUDE.md\`, and the other names that pi uses) go into the system prompt`],
      [`pi-action uses the \`AGENTS.md\` of the branch.`, `pi-action uses the context files of the branch.`]],
    "README.md": [[`puts your \`AGENTS.md\` (or \`CLAUDE.md\`) into the system prompt, as pi does,`, `puts your \`AGENTS.md\` (or \`CLAUDE.md\`, and the other names that pi uses) into the system prompt, as pi does,`],
      [`| \`context_files\` | Put \`AGENTS.md\` (or \`CLAUDE.md\`) into`, `| \`context_files\` | Put the context files (\`AGENTS.override.md\`, \`AGENTS.md\`, \`CLAUDE.md\`, ...) into`]],
    "action.yml": [[`Put the repository''s AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md) into`, `Put the repository''s context files (AGENTS.override.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, ...) into`]],
    "CONTRIBUTING.md": [[`The context files (\`AGENTS.md\`, \`CLAUDE.md\`) and`, `The context files (\`AGENTS.override.md\`, \`AGENTS.md\`, \`CLAUDE.md\`, ...) and`]],
    "src/inputs.ts": [[`whether AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md) goes into`, `whether the context files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, ...) go into`]],
  };
  for (const [f, reps] of Object.entries(edits)) {
    const r = await read(f, { format: "raw" });
    let c = r.content;
    for (const [a, b] of reps) { if (!c.includes(a)) throw new Error(f + " missing " + a.slice(0, 50)); c = c.replace(a, b); }
    await edit(f, { revision: r.revision, changes: [{ kind: "replaceFile", content: c }] });
  }
}
